results.title: St. Maarten hosts its first Human Rights Conference
results.description: Dignitaries in attendance. PHILIPSBURG--The Ministry of Justice and the Council of Europe hosted St. Maarten’s first Human Rights Conference on Friday, October 9, at the University of St. Martin, bringing together government officials, justice institutions, legal professionals, civil society, students and members of the public to discuss human rights and the country’s responsibilities in protecting them.
